Title: Large storage for Azure Database for PostgreSQL now in preview

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce support for up to 16TB of storage and up to 20,000 IOPS in Azure Database for PostgreSQL. With this preview, we are not only providing five times more storage for your database servers, but also more than triple the available IOPS. This ensures that you can run your most demanding, large scale workloads on Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

Learn more in the related Azure Database for PostgreSQL documentation.
